$comment: Source of truth for the Structa Cloud -> ThemeForest rebrand. Consumed by tools/rebrand.mjs. Owning plan: docs/plans/structa-cloud/README.md. Edit this file, never hand-edit a generated publish set.

product.note: canonicalName / canonicalSlug identity the *owning product* for the kit, the plan and the internal docs. They are deliberately NOT used as marketplace item metadata - see marketplace.rule below.

marketplace.rule: Brand-free standard naming. Marketplace item metadata (item name, slug, tags, listing copy) names the *product*, never the vendor brand. The owning product is identified in the kit's own docs and in this plan, both outside the listing fields.
marketplace.rationale: A buyer purchases a product, not the vendor's brand. Keeps every item portable across future vendor naming, and stops one brand's retired names from reaching a listing that outlives the rename.
marketplace.enforcement: Scoped to listing metadata fields - deliberately NOT a file-wide denylist rule. A blanket `structa` regex would flag our own fu-attribution band (S2.3), which is required to carry the brand. Enforce where the listing is authored (S5.1), and against the kit's item-name string via R1/R2 only.

decisions.question: Replace the upstream copyright notices and the 'Histudy' name in projects/assets/theme/default/?
decisions.resolution: No. The archive is excluded from every publish set and is never rewritten. Structa Cloud attribution is added on authored surfaces instead (the fu-attribution band).
decisions.rationale: Removing a copyright notice does not clear a licence: the markup, SCSS and imagery in that tree remain derivative of a commercial ThemeForest item. Renaming it would convert a defensible exclusion into a review-rejection and takedown risk.
consequences: Structa Cloud branding lands in engine/components/_fu-attribution.scss and preview.html.
Any publish set must be assembled from authored surfaces only.

decisions.question: Should the marketplace item carry the company brand, as the kit's existing title ('Precis - Unified LMS & Landing Platform') does?
decisions.resolution: No. Marketplace item metadata is brand-free and follows the standard <Theme Name> - <Purpose descriptor> pattern with a <theme>-<purpose> slug. The brand-bearing item name is replaced by the brand-free 4th item, 'Aperture - LMS, Landing & Research Suite' (aperture-suite).
decisions.rationale: The naming policy was set by the operator after the kit rebrand (S4) was first drafted with the brand in the item name. It supersedes the brand-bearing item name recorded in the previous revision of this map.
consequences: R2 now installs a brand-free item name instead of a brand-bearing one.
R1's kit title drops the brand for the same reason.
A file-wide brand denylist must NOT be added: it would flag the authored fu-attribution band, which is required to carry the brand.

surfaces.label: Token-only theme variations
surfaces.note: Two files per variation (token partial + activation block). The palettes are authored, but every token name inherits the undecided fu-<name>-* prefix, so they wait on B1 like the engine.

surfaces.label: Theme engine (shared token/remap layer)
surfaces.note: The fu-<theme>-* token prefix and fu-* BEM blocks are the product's public class contract AND the upstream template's class namespace. Provenance must be settled before a rename.

surfaces.label: Histudy-derived archive
surfaces.note: Vendored from the commercial 'Histudy - Online Courses & Education Bootstrap5 Template' (Rainbow-Themes). Carries the upstream author's copyright notice and ThemeForest purchase link. Must be excluded from any publish set, not renamed.

surfaces.label: Authored layers over the default theme
surfaces.note: Newly authored design systems, but they extend the fu-default-* token names inherited from the archive.

surfaces.label: Product-owned attribution band
surfaces.note: The authored colophon carrying the Structa Cloud mark, name and copyright. Block name fu-attribution is deliberately distinct from the vendored .fu-footer so the two never collide. Authored under the B2 decision (see decisions[]).

denylist.label: Upstream theme attribution
denylist.reason: Third-party template identity. A publish set must contain none of it.

denylist.label: Upstream purchase / author link
denylist.reason: Another author's ThemeForest URL must never appear in our item.

denylist.label: Copyright notice that is not ours
denylist.reason: A rights notice that does not name Structa Cloud within 400 characters is someone else's claim (or one we cannot substantiate). The window is generous because vendored notices wrap across lines, and `\s+` is required for the same reason. Our own authored notice names Structa Cloud and therefore passes.

denylist.label: External placeholder media
denylist.reason: M6 claim gate: no external placeholder media. Matches a live URL only, so the checklist that names these hosts is not flagged.

denylist.label: Retired product name
denylist.reason: Retired names must not ship in a publish set. VResume added 2026-09-21: the portfolio product was merged into the unified product, and its name survived in test fixtures (fixed) and in the marketplace kit's title.

denylist.label: Unsubstantiated authorship claim
denylist.reason: True only once the publish set is authored-only (milestone S2).

denylist.label: Unresolved rework marker
denylist.reason: Buyer-facing output carries no authoring leftovers.
